## Let's discuss the 5 ps

Two examples together involving competitions.

1.  [World Cube Association](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/rankings/333/single?)

2.  [ICE Employees](https://theicelist.org/index.php/Category:Agents)

Three examples to get you thinking for your response. 


## World Cube Association

3x3 solver [Olaf Kuźmiński](https://youtu.be/xpmcqOZp5PQ?si=RxQNsfcM_yJhOuv1&t=721)

[Olaf's Page](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2018KUZM02)



Scenerio: We write an article on Olaf's Rubic's cube career. What are the five p s?

What should we do to be as ethical as possible?

When does it become unethical?


## ICE Data part 1

Scenerio: The organization [ICE List](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ICE_List) maintains a website with ICE officer's information. This lists public officials, whose personal infromation [exists on the internet](https://theicelist.org/index.php/Category:Agents). According to wikipedia ICE List maintains that, "much the information... is gathered from public databases (such as Linkedin)..." linkedin. 

From ICE List's point of view, what are the five ps? 


## Boston Marthon

Results for the [Boston Marathon](https://www.baa.org/races/boston-marathon/results/)

Scenerio: We write an article on [Whit Blair](https://www.baa.org/races/boston-marathon/results/?runner=119) winner of 2025 non-binary category.

What are the five p s?


## ICE Data part 2

Scenerio: The US government maintains a databse on Imigration and Customs Enforcement Detainees. That is, people who are being detained due to their lack of citizenship in the US. Information for these individuals also exists on the internet [here](https://locator.ice.gov/odls/#/search).  

Consider the five ps from the Us Government's point of view? 


## School Sports

Scenerio: We are writing an article on the local school sports team. We may be writing about a star soccer player, the captain of the wrestling team or the best track and field player. 

What are the five ps from our point of view?
